description: Get the content of every page on a site in one job, for RAG, indexing or site-wide export. Use when you need many pages from one domain; for one URL use alterlab_scrape, for a URL list only use alterlab_map. Cost: the alterlab_scrape rate per page crawled, from $0.0002 up to $0.02. Works on JavaScript-heavy and protected sites. Returns a crawl_id immediately; results are available from GET /api/v1/crawl/{crawl_id}. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

approval_id.description: Approval for work above the key's approval_above_usd threshold. Such work returns status pending_approval with an approval_url and next_action; show the URL to your human, then resubmit the identical request with the approval_id once alterlab_approval reports approved.

max_tier.description: Advanced; leave unset unless you know the target works at this tier. A cap below the tier a domain needs fails the request ("this domain requires at least tier N, but your request is capped at tier M") and is not raised for you. Use max_credits to bound spend instead.

dry_run.description: Free estimate only: returns per-item predicted tier and cost, totals in microcents and USD, predicted time and a remaining-budget check. Nothing is dispatched or charged. A budget the estimate would exceed is rejected with the non-retryable spend_limit_would_exceed. Default false.

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

include_subdomains.description: Include subdomains of the site. Default: false.

list.description: Paginated list crawl: fetch url_template page by page (no link following) until stop_when, max_pages, max_credits or an error stops it. Billed per page fetched; resume with POST /crawl/{id}/resume. Status returns deduplicated items and stopped_reason.

item_key.description: Item identity: url, jsonld:@id or selector:<css>. Default: url.

max_pages.description: Hard ceiling on pages fetched. Default: 50.

no_new_items.description: Stop after this many consecutive pages with no new items. Default: 2.

url_template.description: URL containing a {page} placeholder, e.g. https://x.com/rent?page={page}

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth from the start URL. Default: 3.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. 'auto' renders only when needed. Default: false.

tag.description: Optional spend-attribution tag (lowercase letters, digits, _ . -; max 64 chars; up to 20 active tags per organization). Usage and spend are reported per tag, and a tag with a max_spend_usd budget stops accepting new work with 402 tag_budget_exhausted once the cap is reached.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.

name: alterlab_crawl
title: Crawl Website
